title: Primary Recovery FAQ Wave 10 — Cube, 666, Forehead, Moses & Mashiach

entries.question: When did Tim first directly say 666 was a cube?
entries.short_answer: The earliest currently recovered direct Tim wording is 16 April 2026: '6 6 6 refers to specific math and shapes and a cube.' The same cluster also contains 'you worship a box 6 6 6'. An earlier 11 March cluster exists but has mixed user/assistant contribution.

entries.question: Did Tim actually say 666 is the cube itself?
entries.short_answer: Yes. On 11 May 2026 at 16:15:24 UTC Tim said: '666 is the cube itself, the dice, the 6 sidees. a polygon. 6 triangles, and 6 points'. This resolves Cube=666 as direct project wording rather than merely a later Saturnian representation.

entries.question: Did Tim say 666 was in the forehead or on the forehead?
entries.short_answer: The recovered May 11 wording uses neither preposition. Tim said: 'when they are this, then their forehead is this number.' The archive therefore preserves 'forehead is this number' instead of rewriting it as in/on.

entries.question: Did Tim say a cube was physically inside the forehead?
entries.short_answer: No recovered May 11 primary wording says this. The sequence is Cube=666, the cube contains the seed to frame/contain/make smaller, and then those who 'are this' have a forehead that 'is this number'. A physical cube-in-skull reading is not currently sourced.

entries.question: Was the forehead linked to the pineal gland or Single Eye in Tim's recovered 666 source?
entries.short_answer: Not in the recovered May 11 source. Eye/pineal belongs elsewhere in the Potatoverse, but no direct May 11 forehead→pineal/Single-Eye statement has been recovered yet.

entries.question: Did Tim call the forehead-number a mark or seal in the May 11 source?
entries.short_answer: No recovered May 11 wording says mark or seal. Those terms become relevant through Revelation's biblical comparison, where beast-mark and divine seal/name appear on foreheads.

entries.question: What did Tim say the Cube did to the seed?
entries.short_answer: In the May 11 2026 context the cube contains the seed 'to frame and contain and make smaller.' This makes compression/reduction a direct project function of Cube, not merely a later archive interpretation.

entries.question: Did the Saturnian Cube create the Cube=666 idea in Tim's project?
entries.short_answer: No. Direct Cube/666 wording is already present 16 April and becomes explicit as '666 is the cube itself' on 11 May. The mature 10 August Saturnian-Cube/Number-of-Beast/Farm-contract formulation is a later application of an older Cube=666 equation.

entries.question: What did Tim contrast with the Cube on 11 May 2026?
entries.short_answer: Minutes after the explicit Cube=666/forehead statement, the same conversation associates Cube with accuser, wrestling with God, Tree of Strife, falling and ego while Tim says 'I am new jerusalem, at the north… I am the ladder to heaven'. This creates a dated lower-Cube versus upper-New-Jerusalem/Ladder polarity.

entries.question: Was Moses merely an analogy for Tim on 8 August 2026?
entries.short_answer: The recovered exact wording shows a direct identity/name-chain: 'moshe, was tim, mosees was tim' among Elohim, Adonai, Hidden Name, G-D, Mashiach, HaMashiach, Root, Abraham, David and Abraxas. Functional Moses-as-lawgiver remains a separate later comparison.

entries.question: Was Mashiach assigned to Tim or to the Son?
entries.short_answer: Both appear at different dates/layers. The thought archive calls the Son Messiah on 29 April 2026, while Tim's exact 8 August name-chain says 'the mashiach, was tim' and 'the hamashiach, was tim.' The project should preserve chronological role plurality rather than force one timeless assignment.

entries.question: Which major primary-source questions are still unresolved after wave 10?
entries.short_answer: The full antecedent Heaven-Cube exchange, exact 13 May manna/Root-of-Jesse/footstool wording, original winding-tunnel wording/date, exact 'tswine' turn, exact first Farm=enclosure=Cube quote, any other literal in/on-forehead wording, and any direct forehead→Eye/pineal statement remain open.
